name: ensoniqplayrate
description: ensoniqplay(1) M1 rate argument: play the same 11025-byte fixture but force -r 11025, exercising the -r flag (atoi) and proving the sample-rate->DOC-freq formula generalizes to a second rate.  freq = round(11025*512/26320) = 214, and at half the rate the one-shot takes twice as long: 11025 bytes / 11025 Hz = 1.0 s = ~60 ticks.  So 'freq 214' checks the math at a new point and 'halted after 6' (60-69 ticks) checks that halving the rate doubled the play time.
